data.businessDescription: Veidekke ASA engages in building construction and civil engineering activities. It operates through the following segments: Construction Norway, Infrastructure Norway, Construction Sweden, Infrastructure Swede, Denmark, and Others. The company was founded on February 6, 1936 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

Equinor ASA engages in the exploration, production, transport, refining, and marketing of petroleum and petroleum-derived products. Segments: Exploration and Production Norway, E&P International, E&P USA, Marketing, Midstream, and Processing, Renewables, and Other. Ultimate parent: Norway (state). Founded 1972, headquartered in Stavanger, Norway.

data.businessDescription: Xior Student Housing NV operates as a real estate company, which engages in the provision of student housing services. It operates through the Belgium and The Netherlands geographical segments. It offers a variety of accommodation from rooms with communal facilities to en-suite rooms and fully equipped studios. The company was founded by Christian Teunissen in 2007 and is headquartered in Antwerp, Belgium.

D'Ieteren Group engages in the distribution, replacement, and repair of automobile and motor vehicles parts. Segments: D'Ieteren Auto (distributes Volkswagen group brands in Belgium), Belron (vehicle glass repair and replacement: Carglass, Safelite AutoGlass, Autoglass), Moleskine, TVH, and PHE (spare parts to independent dealers). Founded 1805, headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

Currys Plc is an electrical and telecommunications retailer and services company. It operates through the following geographical segments: United Kingdom and Ireland, Nordics, and Greece. Founded in 1937, headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Atalaya Mining Copper SA is a mining and development group that produces copper concentrates and silver by-product. It operates Rio Tinto Copper Project and its activities are located in Spain. Founded 2004, headquartered in Minas de Riotinto, Spain.

Sanoma Oyj engages in the provision of consumer media and learning solutions. It operates through the Learning and Media Finland segments. Learning provides multi-channel learning solutions for teachers in primary, secondary, and vocational education. Media Finland includes newspapers, television, radio, magazines, online. Founded 1889, headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.

Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and distribution of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Segments: North America, Middle Americas, South America, EMEA, Asia Pacific, Global Export and Holding Companies. Founded 1977, headquartered in Leuven, Belgium.

Informa Plc provides information, advanced knowledge, and exhibition and events solutions. Segments: Informa Connect, Informa Markets, Informa Tech, Informa Intelligence, and Taylor & Francis (scholarly research publishing). Founded 1998, headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Tieto Corp. (Tietoevry) engages in the provision of software and digital services. Segments: Tietoevry Create (advisory, data engineering, software R&D services), Tietoevry Banking, Tietoevry Care (health and social care software), Tietoevry Industry, and Tietoevry Tech Services (cloud/infrastructure). Founded 1968, headquartered in Espoo, Finland.

GSK Plc is a healthcare company, which engages in the research, development, and manufacture of pharmaceutical medicines and vaccines. Segments: Commercial Operations (specialty medicines, vaccines, general medicines) and Total R&D. Headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Clariant AG engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of specialty chemicals. Segments: Care Chemicals, Catalysis, Natural Resources (oil and mining services, functional minerals, additives), and Corporate. Founded 1995, headquartered in Muttenz, Switzerland.

SigmaRoc Plc engages in the production of lime and limestone, aggregates and supply of industrial and construction materials. Segments: United Kingdom and Ireland, Western Europe, Nordics, and Central Europe. Founded 2004, headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

data.businessDescription: Corticeira Amorim SGPS SA manufactures and sells cork-based products. Segments: Raw Materials, Cork Stoppers, Floor and Wall Coverings, Composite Cork, Insulation Cork, and Holding. Ultimate parent: Amorim - Investimentos e Participacoes (family holding). Founded 1870, headquartered in Santa Maria da Feira, Portugal.

Hellenic Telecommunications Organization SA (OTE) provides telecommunication services: fixed-line, internet, ICT and TV in Greece (OTE) and mobile (COSMOTE). Ultimate parent: Deutsche Telekom AG. Founded 1949, headquartered in Maroussi, Greece.

Terveystalo Oyj provides outpatient healthcare services to corporate, private, and public sector customers. Segments: Healthcare Services (Finland: occupational health, primary care, specialized care, diagnostics, day surgery), Portfolio Businesses, and Sweden (Feelgood occupational health). Founded 2001, headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Ambulatory and Outpatient Patient Care

data.businessDescription: Evolution AB engages in the development, production, marketing, and licensing of business to business casino solutions to gaming operators. It provides live casino studios, land-based live casino, mobile live casino, and live casino for television. Founded 2006, headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Addnode Group AB engages in the acquisition, operation, and development of companies that supply software and digital services. Segments: Design Management, Product Lifecycle Management, and Process Management. Founded 1986, headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Ipsen SA manufactures pharmaceutical products for oncology, neuroscience, and rare diseases: Somatuline, Cabometyx, Onivyde, Decapeptyl, Nutropin, Increlex (and Dysport in neuroscience). Founded 1929 by Henri Beaufour, headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.

DWS Group GmbH & Co. KGaA is a financial holding company engaged in asset management services, offering traditional and alternative investment solutions to private investors and institutions. Ultimate parent: Deutsche Bank AG. Founded 1956, headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany.
